review_scope: Read-only independent geometry review of current measured input; no changes to track, solver or simulation.

checks.interpretation: Unshrunk smooth spline tube differs from original piecewise-linear boundary polygon, including sampled boundary points; do not claim exact polygon identity.
Configured ORCA half-width clearance keeps all sampled spline tube points inside original paired boundary polygon and inferred usable mask.

method: Evaluate Track.reference at equally spaced arc samples over one period, excluding duplicate endpoint.
For each reference, use the spline unit left normal and linearly interpolated paired widths; sample 101 transverse positions between right+clearance and left-clearance.
Query map_evidence.npz usable mask with floor((XY-origin)/0.05), treating out-of-grid as outside.
Test points inside right_boundary.csv outer polygon and outside left_boundary.csv inner polygon using matplotlib.path.Path.
Compare spline-derived sample tangents/paired limits to CSV yaw and boundary vertices.
limitations: Finite spatial sampling, not an analytic continuous containment proof.
Structural usable mask does not certify low-obstacle absence or real-vehicle clearance.
This audit is bound to the input hashes; it does not validate arbitrary future CSV edits.
Original boundary polygon test at zero clearance includes boundary classification conventions.
Simulation lap success must be checked separately from geometry validity.
